text: Firelink Shrine contains five great thrones meant to hold the Lords of Cinder before their final sacrifice.
The Undead Settlement is a place where kingdoms exile cursed and afflicted undead away from normal society.
The Undead Settlement and Firelink Shrine became recurring way stations across the ages where undead gather before journeying to link the flame.
The Crucifixion Woods surrounding the Road of Sacrifices are inhabited by insane undead who ambush travelers.
Farron Keep is a poisonous swamp region that acts as a natural barrier protecting the fortress and headquarters of the Undead Legion, the Abyss Watchers, and was once something greater.
The catacombs of Carthus feature collapsing bridges, traps, reanimated skeleton warriors that reassemble after being destroyed, and giant rolling bone wheels.
Deep within the catacombs of Carthus, the architecture gives way to a natural cavern filled with a physical manifestation of the Abyss.
Beyond the Carthus catacombs lies a passage leading to the frozen valley of Irithyll of the Boreal Valley.
Irithyll of the Boreal Valley is a frozen city with silver spires, patrolled by Pontiff Knights and Outriders.
The Irithyll Dungeon is a network of cells and torture chambers beneath Irithyll where Pontiff Sulyvahn's regime imprisoned and disposed of threats to its authority.
The Profaned Capital is a ruined city covered in ash, with streets sunk into poisonous swamps, once ruled by Yhorm the Giant.
The Grand Archives of Lothric house generations of accumulated knowledge, but the books themselves are cursed and attack intruders.
After the Three Pillars fell, the Ashen One ascended via lift through a garden and bridge to the highest tower where Prince Lothric and Lorian waited.
The Ringed City is a sanctuary built for the Pygmies, humanity's oldest ancestors, hidden at the very end of the world.
The Ringed City takes place at the literal end of time and space, where all ages of the world collapse together in the Dreg Heap.
The Dreg Heap is a chaotic landscape formed from the collapsed ruins of many different eras and kingdoms piled on top of each other.
Fragments of Lothric Castle and pieces of Anor Londo can be found jutting from the wreckage of the Dreg Heap.
Filianore's Rest is a sanctum at the heart of the Ringed City where Filianore has slept for ages since her father placed her there.
The ashen desert of the far future contains the thrones where Pygmy Kings once ruled, now buried in dunes of gray ash.
Gwyn established his seat of power at Anor Londo, a city of white stone bathed in eternal sunlight.

Archdragon Peak is accessible only through meditation and a specific gesture, and is home to the Dragon Covenant, a sanctuary created by the Nameless King for those who wished to follow the dragons and transcend humanity to become dragons.
The Painted World of Ariandel is a realm created on canvas, meant as a refuge for outcasts, but is found rotting with a corruption resembling scarlet rot.
